headline: Grupo Andino Acquires Spanish Logistics and Port Company Quimgra
summary: Grupo Andino acquired 100% of Quimgra, a company operating in the Spanish ports of Cádiz and Castellón with over 200,000 tons of annual capacity.
why: Cross-border logistics acquisitions expand port infrastructure footprints and international freight handling capabilities.

impacts.name: Grupo Andino
impacts.why: Acquiring port logistics assets extends the company's operational scope into Europe.
